entries.en: Wh-What was that...?[n]Was that really a person!?
I saw it head on... That was[n]a student from our school,[n]right? Who was that?
Someone fell from the roof?[n]Oh, god, she's not moving!

entries.speaker: Concerned Female Student
entries.en: Hey, did you see her fall?[n]I wonder if she's okay...

entries.speaker: Dismayed Female Student
entries.en: Yeah, I saw it. After falling from that height,[n]she must be seriously hurt or worse!
